title: Build an Editorial Calendar for an AI Blog Without Burning Out
description: A lean editorial calendar model for founders and solo operators who want consistent output, better internal linking, and room for automation.
excerpt: A sustainable calendar is less about volume and more about repeatable series, category ownership, and automatic follow-up assets like indexes and email hooks.
author: MyAppAI Editorial

video.title: Build an Editorial Calendar for an AI Blog Without Burning Out background video
video.attribution: Video source: Pexels free video library.

sections.heading: Why this matters
sections.body: Choose a few durable categories and publish clusters instead of random one-off topics.

sections.heading: How the workflow should be structured
sections.body: Use a numbered archive so readers and search engines can see momentum at a glance.

sections.heading: What to automate and what to review
sections.body: Pair each article with one primary CTA and one internal link destination. That prevents monetization from feeling bolted on.

sections.heading: Where this creates revenue leverage
sections.body: Automation should generate the repetitive scaffolding, not erase the editorial point of view.
